entries.15748d48f7101099: It mainly delivers small cargo on the same day. Revenue by individual business is not disclosed.
entries.32ee1ddc85e25876: It leases offices, residences and warehouses it owns, and develops and sells logistics facilities. entries.8410af473b2f0117: It consists of a human resources business, which dispatches and places staff working at logistics centers and other facilities; an environmental business, which handles everything from waste collection to recycling; a marketing business, including advertising production; and a solar power generation business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥10,778 million.
entries.9dc00bfb7b28f400: A logistics holding company whose core is 3PL and 4PL, comprehensively undertaking the logistics of shipper companies.
entries.c2f7d3438bdbc845: Using its nationwide network, it transports food in the three temperature zones of frozen, refrigerated and ambient. Revenue by individual business is not disclosed.
entries.f7c04fe58878b3d0: It transports and delivers materials, products and other items from the warehouses and factories of client companies. Revenue by individual business is not disclosed.
